issue.title: [Feature] Add s2graphql command for JSON Structure to GraphQL SDL
issue.body:
### What should Avrotize let you do?

Convert a JSON Structure definition into a GraphQL SDL schema with proper type mappings, nullable fields, and enum support.

### Requested command, API, MCP, or VS Code capability

s2graphql

### Starting definition or data

JSON Structure (.struct.json) with records, enums, references, and unions:
```json
{"type":"record","name":"User","fields":[{"name":"id","type":"string"},{"name":"role","type":{"type":"enum","symbols":["ADMIN","USER"]}}]}
```

### Requested output or result

GraphQL SDL (.graphql) with type definitions, enum types, and nullable/non-nullable annotations.

### Semantics that must be preserved

Record names map to GraphQL types, enum symbols to enum values, references to type references, optional fields to nullable, and namespace to schema directive.

### Flags, options, and defaults

--naming: camel (default), pascal, snake
--nullable-by-default: false (default)
--federation: false (default), adds @key directives

### Validation and runtime expectations

The output should pass `graphql-js` schema validation. Round-trip is not expected since GraphQL has fewer type features.

### Documentation example

```shell
avrotize s2graphql user.struct.json user.graphql --naming camel
```
Produces:
```graphql
type User {
  id: String!
  role: Role!
}
enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
```

### Confirmation

- [X] I described the outcome and semantics, not only an implementation.
